Irish Cream Cocktail
By: Andie Mitchell
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 9:41am

Ingredients




1 ounce Chambord
2 ounces Bailey's Irish Cream
6 ounces Milk or creamer or to taste

Preparation

1 Put the chambord, Irish Cream, and milk or creamer in a shaker with ice. Shake, strain and poor into glass. Add the milk or creamer to your own personal taste.
